Title: REHAB - ROOFTOP SESSION #3 (GEANNULEERD)
Description: REHAB ROOFTOP SESSION #3Rehab is back with the 3rd drum and bass rooftop session on top of Wilde Westen!Good vibes, quality soundsystem and great line-up for a perfect closing of your summer. FD (The North Quarter, UK)Developing a love for music through London’s pirate radio waves and the energy of the city’s rave scene, FD’s journey has always been one driven by feeling. Those early days spent recording mix tapes and chasing the emotionof certain records naturally led towards DJing and soon after the need tocreate his own music followed.As a DJ, FD’s sets are journeys built from a long-standing love andunderstanding of the music, showcasing the full spectrum of drum & bass, inall it’s depth, emotion and versatility, revealing how its tempo can carry aworld of ideas and influences. Having played at some of the scene’s mostrespected clubs and festivals around the world, he continues to represent hisown vision and belief in what makes this music truly special. Redeyes (Five Alley, The North Quarter, FR)Redeyes is a versatile producer from Toulouse, known for his soulful and genre-blending music.His work spans across Drum & Bass, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Soul, Funk, and House, creating a rich and diverse soundscape.A prominent artist on The North Quarter label,Redeyes has released acclaimed albums like“Broken Soul” in 2018 and “Selfportraits” in 2020. These works highlight his ability to seamlessly navigate different genres and tempos, showcasing his detailed and soulful production style! One87This DJ, producer, and promoter is a true pioneer of the Belgian drum & bass scene. As the mastermind behind the legendary Star Warz nights in Ghent, he is a champion of innovative sounds and shapes the culture.In close collaboration with Rampage, he hosts an annual stage where he curates the line-up. With releases on Critical, Dispatch & Flexout Audio, expect nothing less than deep, dark & rolling energy when he steps up! Respect The BreakzA drum and bass collective that includes Try One, Split Personality & VIKI is ready to conquer Kortrijk! With their own experience behind the decks, they decided to collaborate as a trio to show their knowledge. Sisley & BenOneShotSisley & BenOneShot are a must-see duo on the Belgian Drum and Bass scene. This explosive tandem is known for their powerful and energetic sets, capable of electrifying any crowd. Their unique style spans from jungle to “dancefloor killers”, “rolling steppers” and soulful drum and bass, always seeking out the rhythms that make people move.Regularly featured at the biggest Drum and Bass events in Belgium, they’ve made their mark at Dour, Tomorrowland and Starwarz, to name just a few. With a perfect blend of musicality and raw energy, their performances strike a delicate balance between power and harmony. Each performance is a thrilling journey, with seamless transitions and a high energy atmosphere.Whether on international or local stages, Sisley & BenOneShot know how to captivate their audience. Get ready, because every set is a wild ride you won’t want to miss! MDRLRMDRLR (also known as Madruler) is an Antwerp-based DJ, producer, and promoter who has been a staple of the Belgian electronic music underground for over three decades. He is most recognized for his dedication to atmospheric jungle, drumfunk, and deep, soulful drum & bass. Swift (NL)Every now and then you come across an MC who actually complements the music, Swift is certainly one of them. With his distinctive voice Swift brings something extra to the table. Swift is mostly known as a Drum and bass & Dubstep MC, but he actually fits any type of bassheavy music.Hailing from the urban jungle that is Rotterdam, Swift unexpectedly became one of Holland's most prolific MC's. Starting as an MC by accident, from the first second he picked up a mic there was no denying his talent. MC NiceBeing the host MC at some of the biggest stages and festivals, MC NIice has become one of the leading voices of the bass-music scene in Belgium. With his short bars and hyper lyrics, Nice adds pure energy to the sound! Inspired by some old school Renegade Hardware mix-tapes, he started writing lyrics around the millennium years. + Residents: Twogun & Likewize
